title: Case 005: Request about a transfer to the wrong recipient
initial_request: I sent a £286.40 transfer for a shared pottery-studio bill to the wrong saved recipient. Please register a request to seek its return.
overview: Leona Mercer contacted Harrow & Vale Bank plc after noticing that a transfer shown as sent in her secure portal had gone to the wrong saved recipient. After completing identification checks on a verified call, she asked H&V to initiate the prescribed return request. The payment team registered the request; no return of the money is confirmed.

next_action.summary: The agent will submit a request to the payment team to register a return request for the verified transfer.

outcome: The payment team confirmed that the return request was registered. Whether the money will be returned remains unconfirmed.

events.body: Transfer status: sent. This status confirms the transfer was sent from your H&V account; it does not confirm that the recipient has returned the money.
I selected the wrong saved recipient for my pottery-studio bill transfer. My identity checks are complete, and I want H&V to register a request to seek the money's return.
I have verified the payer and checked the transfer details for case HV-005. Please register the prescribed request to seek a return; the customer has confirmed the recipient was selected in error.
I have registered the return request for case HV-005 against the verified transfer. Registration does not confirm that the money will be returned.
Request status: registered. H&V has registered your request to seek a return of the transfer; a return of the money is not confirmed.
